summary: Frontend-only testing of reviewcepat.com landing page (ProductPage) and /business page. Covered hero, device stage, glass tags, CTA WhatsApp links, smooth scroll to #cara-kerja, all required sections, bento tiles, categories marquee, tap sequence, FAQ accordion expand, mobile hamburger menu, cross-page navigation (nav-faq from /business navigates to /#faq), biz hero headline, biz model cards, biz WhatsApp CTA, biz-path-* links. 48/50 checks passed.

ui_bugs.issue: 4px horizontal overflow on 390px viewport (scrollWidth=394, clientWidth=390). Likely a decorative absolutely-positioned element or marquee content pushing viewport width. Check Hero/DeviceStage/Marquee negative margins or oversized blur orbs.

issues: Masked reveal uses separate span/divs per word without trailing spaces, so textContent concatenates as 'DapatkanReview Googledengan 1 Tap'. Visually fine (line breaks), but screen readers and SEO/text-based checks will not see 'Dapatkan Review Google dengan 1 Tap' as a single string. Consider adding whitespace via aria-label on the h1 or inserting a space between masked word spans.

action_items: Investigate 4px horizontal overflow on mobile (390px) viewport on homepage
Add aria-label='Dapatkan Review Google dengan 1 Tap' to the hero h1 (or restore inter-word spaces) so the full phrase is accessible as a continuous string
critical_code_review_comments: Lenis console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position (relative/fixed/absolute)' — add position:relative to the Lenis wrapper (likely in SmoothScroll.jsx) to silence and ensure correct scroll offset.
WhatsApp number +6281234567890 is placeholder by design — ensure replaced before production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testid selectors verified on both / and /business pages. CTA WhatsApp URLs are properly prefixed with https://wa.me/6281234567890 and have target=_blank. FAQ accordion toggles aria-expanded correctly. Cross-page nav-faq routes work. Only remaining items are a 4px mobile horizontal overflow and headline textContent spacing (minor). No console errors — only a Lenis non-static-container warning.
